The batch 30 authoring is complete: **22 A-page items and 2 B-page items**, with dependency levels 0–7. The A/B drafts, manifest, coverage, proof contracts, notes and empty cross-batch dependency input are recorded in the [batch manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-30.pages.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-30.coverage.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-30.proof-contracts.json) and [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-30.notes.md). The notes record the conflict between the older QC27 design prerequisites and the controlling current plan.

All **scoped checks passed**: proof layout (24 items, 64 steps), precheck, strict contracts (105 exact supplier citations), dependency and forward-reference checks, content policy, rendering, coverage checklist (52 harvested results), and source-fetch verification (5 page-scoped records covering 3 full-text sources). The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-computing/toric-code-anyons-logical-operators-and-protection.md) and [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/quantum-computing/toric-code-anyons-logical-operators-and-protection-examples.md) remain drafts; the B page includes the TikZ fundamental-domain diagram.

**Readiness records remain blocked.** The required `step1-decisions record` command aborted before writing because `lem-it-quantum-relative-entropy-support-regularization` is duplicated in batches 21 and 22. The whole-run dependency check also reports empty inventories and other mismatches outside this batch. I made no out-of-scope edits and used no `--owner` bypass. The batch 30 dependency graph itself is clean; the exact blockers are documented in the notes.

The three full-text treatments recorded are [Kitaev](https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/9707021), [Dennis–Kitaev–Landahl–Preskill](https://arxiv.org/pdf/quant-ph/0110143), and [Preskill, Chapter 9](https://www.preskill.caltech.edu/ph219/topological.pdf). The authored results stay within the finite model and make no positive claims about material phases, small local perturbation stability, or thermal lifetime.
